invariants.name: EIP-712 Signature Single-Use Uniqueness
invariants.formalStatement: forall digest in ConsumedDigests: verifyAndRelease(digest) reverts SignatureAlreadyConsumed
invariants.violationMechanism: Neither ClaimData nor Distributor tracks consumed digests or sequential nonces.

invariants.name: Performance Fee Hurdle Consistency
invariants.violationMechanism: Replaying earlier voucher forces valuation at historical low price, resulting in zero carry fee calculation.

invariants.name: Carry Withdrawal Authorization Monotonicity
invariants.violationMechanism: Public withdrawCarry allows repeated replay of a single voucher up to contract balance or carry pool limit.
